cases.question: How many customers are there?
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer AS T1 INNER JOIN Employee AS T2 ON T1.SupportRepId = T2.EmployeeId WHERE T1.Country = 'Canada'
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer

cases.question: List the names of all genres in alphabetical order.
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre ORDER BY Name
cases.reference_sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre ORDER BY Name

cases.question: Which country has the most customers? Show the country and the number of customers.
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT T1.Country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer AS T1 INNER JOIN Employee AS T2 ON T1.SupportRepId = T2.EmployeeId GROUP BY T1.Country ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1
cases.reference_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the total revenue across all invoices?
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice

cases.question: Which artists have more than 10 albums? Show the artist name and the album count.
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS album_count FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId HAVING COUNT(al.AlbumId) > 10
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS albums FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId HAVING COUNT(al.AlbumId) > 10

cases.question: How many tracks are in the Rock genre?
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Track AS T1 INNER JOIN Genre AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId WHERE T2.Name = 'Rock'
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rock_tracks FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'

cases.question: Which customers are from Brazil? Show first name, last name and email.
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Email FROM Customer c WHERE c.Country = 'Brazil'
cases.reference_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

cases.question: How many invoices were issued in 2013?
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2013'
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoices_2013 FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2013'

cases.question: What is the total invoice revenue per year? Show the year and the revenue.
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate)
cases.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

cases.question: Which customer has spent the most in total? Show their first name, last name and total spent.
cases.candidate_sql:
SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalSpent 
FROM Customer c 
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId 
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId 
GROUP BY c.CustomerId 
ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC 
LIMIT 1
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS total_spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many tracks are longer than 5 minutes?
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS long_tracks FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 500000
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS long_tracks FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 300000

cases.question: Which media type has the most tracks? Show the media type name and the track count.
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 1
cases.reference_sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY tracks DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many albums does Iron Maiden have?
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.AlbumId) FROM Album AS T1 INNER JOIN Artist AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId WHERE T2.Name = 'Iron Maiden'
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS albums FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden'

cases.question: How many tracks are on the playlist called 'Brazilian Music'?
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.TrackId) AS tracks FROM PlaylistTrack AS T1 INNER JOIN Playlist AS T2 ON T1.PlaylistId = T2.PlaylistId WHERE T2.Name = 'Brazilian Music'
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Brazilian Music'

cases.question: Which employee supports the most customers? Show the employee's first name, last name and the number of customers.
cases.candidate_sql:
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS NumberOfCustomers 
FROM Employee e 
JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId 
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId 
ORDER BY NumberOfCustomers DESC 
LIMIT 1
cases.reference_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customers FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: For every employee who has a manager, show the employee's first name, last name and the manager's last name.
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, m.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId
cases.reference_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, m.LastName AS manager_last_name FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId

cases.question: How many distinct billing countries appear on invoices?
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BillingCountry) FROM Invoice
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BillingCountry) AS countries FROM Invoice

cases.question: What is the average invoice total for invoices billed to Germany, rounded to two decimals?
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.Total) / COUNT(i.InvoiceId), 2) AS avg_invoice_total FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Germany'
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS avg_total FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'Germany'

cases.question: Which genre has the longest average track length? Show the genre name and the average length in milliseconds.
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT g.Name, AVG(t.Milliseconds) AS avg_length FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY avg_length DESC LIMIT 1
cases.reference_sql: SELECT g.Name, AVG(t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ms FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY avg_ms DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many tracks does the artist AC/DC have?
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT COUNT(T3.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Artist AS T1 INNER JOIN Album AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId INNER JOIN Track AS T3 ON T2.AlbumId = T3.AlbumId WHERE T1.Name = 'AC/DC'
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

cases.question: What is the total number of tracks sold, meaning the sum of quantities across all invoice lines?
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT SUM(il.Quantity) AS total_tracks_sold FROM InvoiceLine il
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(Quantity) AS tracks_sold FROM InvoiceLine

cases.question: Which sales support agent generated the most invoice revenue? Show first name, last name and total revenue.
cases.candidate_sql:
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS total_revenue 
FROM Employee e 
JOIN Customer c ON e.SupportRepId = c.SupportRepId 
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId 
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId 
WHERE e.Title = 'Sales Support Agent' 
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId 
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC 
LIMIT 1
cases.reference_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS revenue FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which cities have more than one customer? Show the city and the country.

cases.reference_sql: SELECT City, Country FROM Customer GROUP BY City, Country HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

cases.question: How many tracks have no composer listed?
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.TrackId) AS tracks_without_composer FROM Track AS T1 INNER JOIN Genre AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId WHERE T2.Name IS NOT NULL AND T1.Composer IS NULL
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS no_composer FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NULL

cases.question: What is the name of the longest track and how long is it in milliseconds?

cases.reference_sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many customers does each country have? Show the country and the count.
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT T1.Country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer AS T1 INNER JOIN Employee AS T2 ON T1.SupportRepId = T2.EmployeeId
cases.reference_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM Customer GROUP BY Country

cases.question: Which genres have more than 300 tracks? Show the genre name and the track count.
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name HAVING COUNT(t.TrackId) > 300

cases.question: How many distinct tracks appear on more than one playlist?
cases.candidate_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.TrackId) AS tracks FROM PlaylistTrack AS T1 JOIN PlaylistTrack AS T2 ON T1.TrackId = T2.TrackId GROUP BY T1.TrackId HAVING COUNT(T2.TrackId) > 1
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS multi_playlist_tracks FROM (SELECT TrackId FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY TrackId HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
